vetSays.line: 🛡️ Sarah, Alejandro, Maya and Hind met them at the door — 4 put down. Sarah, Alejandro, Maya, Hind are hurt.
🛡️ Sarah, Alejandro, Maya and Hind met them at the door — 4 put down. Sarah, Alejandro, Maya, Hind are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Sarah, Maya, Hind and Fausto met them at the door — 4 put down. Sarah, Maya, Hind, Fausto are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fausto just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hind just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Alejandro just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sarah, Alejandro, Maya and Fausto met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sarah, Alejandro, Maya, Fausto are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Alejandro just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hind just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fausto just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Alejandro, Maya, Hind, Fausto and Tom met them at the door — 5 put down. Alejandro, Maya, Hind, Fausto, Tom are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Scarred Old Big and an eye-head (×3) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Hind strikes the Scarred Old Big.
You don't stroll through the Scarred Old Big.
You don't stroll through the Scarred Old Big.
The Scarred Old Big falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hind just put down Old Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nora and Thabo met them at the door — 2 put down. Nora, Thabo are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Nora met them at the door — 1 put down. Nora is hurt.
